description: If scenarios have Examples tables, create parameterized tests using @pytest.mark.parametrize. Each row becomes a test case. Don't write single tests that only test one example. Example: @pytest.mark.parametrize('input,expected', [(1, 2), (3, 4)])

do.description: Create parameterized tests from Examples tables. Example: @pytest.mark.parametrize('paths,count', [(['p1','p2'], 2), (['p3'], 1)])

guidance.description: Each example row becomes a test case
Test body uses parameters from Examples

dont.description: Don't hardcode single example or duplicate test methods. Example: def test_with_value_1(): (wrong); def test_with_value_2(): (wrong - use parametrize)

guidance.description: Don't hardcode single example when table has multiple
example: paths = ['path1']  # WRONG - ignores other Examples rows

guidance.description: Don't duplicate test methods for each example
Don't write loops inside tests instead of parametrize
example: for case in cases:  # WRONG - use parametrize for isolation
